case.summary: The case was opened after a single suspicious signal on card 10114_0 prompted verification. Evidence showed the card had numerous transactions and the customer confirmed the flagged charge when asked. With no fraud patterns detected and a low probability score, the investigation concluded the activity was legitimate. Actions included verifying with the customer, monitoring the card, issuing a warning, and ultimately closing the case as no fraud.
